title: These are more like napkin material
text:
These are more like napkin material. I think calling these "kitchen towels" is difficult. They are not soft or absorbent the way you would expect a towel to be, the material feels much more like a formal reusable napkin. But because they are 100% cotton and not pre-shrunk, expect shrinkage and wrinkling when washing, which means they aren't going to look nice as reusable napkins after reusing compared to ones that have been less washed and a different size.

All in all, I want to like these, and they are good for some things I guess, but they are not really kitchen towels.
